in_marathi.name: Nagappa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Serpents
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nagappa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Nagappa is a name associated with the serpent deity, Naga. This name is believed to bring the blessings of the Naga gods, symbolizing protection, power, and prosperity.
